summary: Kanzhun Limited filed a Next Day Disclosure Return with the Hong Kong Stock Exchange detailing ongoing share repurchases. The company reported repurchasing 589,716 Class A ordinary shares on June 17, 2026 at approximately USD 6.78 per share, along with 13 other repurchase tranches completed from May 27 through June 17, 2026, all intended for cancellation. Buyback prices ranged from USD 6.67 to USD 7.25, with total repurchased shares exceeding 7.2 million as of June 17. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is noted. The disclosure fulfills HKEX Main Board Rule 13.25A. The capital return activity signals management’s view of undervaluation; watch for continued repurchase velocity and potential buyback program extension.
